method: Manual visual inspection of same-browser captures after automated interaction checks

findings.evidence: Logo, 192px navigation, title geometry, three provider cards, four model rows, typography, spacing and original actions match; only two secondary page-head actions and the collapsed design-demo disclosure are added.
Original two-step provider/model dialog, API protocol, URL, Key, advanced output settings and custom parameter area remain full size and usable.
Original horizontal tabs, two-column options/form, full content review and repair section, and footer actions remain visible behind the scoped import preview.
Original item editor and growth tabs/forms remain the host UI. CR-313 modal uses the same surface, border, type and action hierarchy without replacing the host.
Model additions, updates and removal are individually locatable; count cards agree with the listed rows and the removed item exists in the inherited baseline.

No horizontal overflow. Header, independently scrolling content and fixed footer fit the viewport. Focus ring shown on Close is the intentional initial keyboard focus state, not a persistent skip link.
The interaction lab has no admin navigation and is visually separate from the formal inherited-page design.

scope_limit: Visual evidence proves deterministic local design behavior only; it does not prove real file, encryption, API, database, production app, or provider behavior.
